posts.title: Designing the Morpho album artwork
posts.description: Matt and I have been creating artwork for his music for almost 12 years now. It’s a collaboration I’m immensely proud of, and one that offers a welcome change of scene from my day-to-day job of designing and building websites. posts.title: HTML elements vs tags
posts.description: Last week I received an email from a Practical Hugo student who was struggling to understand my instructions in one of the episodes. As a result, code was added in the wrong place, which subsequently broke their template. It appears the confusion came from a misunderstanding between the terms element and tag . posts.title: The config directory
posts.description: For simple Hugo sites, a single configuration file is usually all you’ll need. However, for bigger projects, with large configurations, it’s often a good idea to split your hugo.toml file into multiple files using the configuration directory .
